evidence: Begin at the Okahu Road end; its 2 hr (7 km) from there to Skips Hut (Whangatawhia).
Walk among the giant trees until you end at the River Rd carpark.
The bike track starts from Okahu Valley Rd and ends at River Road car park.

not_on_route.name: Rangitaiki Plains
not_on_route.quote: spectacular views of the Rangitaiki Plains far below

doubts: No road end features are given, so the Okahu Road end and River Rd car park have no refs. Moerangi Hut is the Day 2 destination but sits about 500 m up a detour from the main track; it is listed as via and as a hut on the way.
